meta.population: UK residents having a baby, counted as people (birth parent and partner each once), from a known pregnancy to the child's first birthday, plus people within 12 months of a pregnancy loss or a baby's death

q_nation._source: Live births 2025: ONS (England, Wales), NRS (Scotland); NISRA 2024 (NI)

q_pregnancy_outcome._source: Stock = flow x time in window. Lancet 2021 miscarriage 15.3% of recognised pregnancies; ONS stillbirth 3.9/1000 and infant mortality 3.9/1000

q_baby_stage._source: Known pregnancy (~34 weeks) vs first year after birth

q_relationship_to_baby._source: Maternities (ONS/NRS/NISRA) + partners from ONS 2025 registration type + DfE/NRS/NISRA adoptions + MoJ parental orders

q_employment_status._source: ONS LFS: ~70% of mothers with child 0-2 employed (incl. maternity leave), ~92.5% of fathers; self-employment and zero-hours shares from LFS

q_has_partner._source: ONS 2025 registration type: 53.2% married/CP + 32.3% cohabiting; asked of birth parents, adopters and everyone after a loss before 24 weeks (model v2)

q_partner_died._source: MBRRACE-UK 2025: deaths during or up to 1 year after pregnancy, ~30 per 100,000 maternities

q_pregnancy_timing._source: Uniform over weeks 6-39.3 of a known pregnancy, plus pregnancies that later miscarry (early weeks)

q_baby_age._source: Uniform over the first year (window ends at first birthday)

q_qualifying_benefits._source: EDITORIAL from DWP UC statistics; refine with Stat-Xplore UC households by age of youngest child = 0

q_other_children_under_16._source: ONS E&W first births 42% (2017, rising); NRS 2025 47% no previous live birth

q_child_disability._source: NCARDRS 2020: congenital anomaly 2.2% of births; 'not known' share EDITORIAL

q_moving._source: EDITORIAL from ONS long-term international migration YE Dec 2025

q_parent_age._source: EDITORIAL from ONS Conceptions in England and Wales 2023
